verdict.rationale: Grok Build is documented as a terminal, headless, and ACP coding agent built around prompt-driven sessions, plan mode, and tool calls. Nothing in the evidence shows inline as-you-type completions or next-edit suggestions. Inline completion is a fair axis for a coding tool, so missing evidence means none rather than na. The note that grok-4.7 can be dropped into an IDE integration refers to the xAI API model, not a Grok Build completion feature.
